scope: Redesign the 4 mounted swords and 12 representative paired materials, consumables and torso garments; no full item-catalog generation, scenes, enemies, techniques or player art
designIntent: Same-family identity must not erase material tier or craft grade. Require a large structural/silhouette cue plus a broad material/craft cue visible at 28-40 px, not only hue, scratches or microscopic patterns.
qualityBoundary: Shared item-ID art expresses material and crafting variant, not a particular instance quality or a guarantee that every higher-tier item beats every lower-tier item in all stats.
referencesPolicy: Use currently mounted art as references; unmounted originals were removed.
